Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced incorrect comparison criteria by instructing the agent to “normalize … prefer the latest full date … to reflect the general/widest release,” which contradicts the task of determining which film came out earlier (requiring the earliest verifiable date). This misprioritization could lead to a wrong conclusion and reflects inconsistent methodology, even though the final outcome happened to be correct due to the large year gap (1942 vs. 2013).
